security.item: Fixed stored XSS via the Author Website field (front-end upload form)
Stricter URL validation: quotes, whitespace, angle brackets and backticks are no longer accepted (PhocaDownloadUtils::isURLAddress).
author_url is validated again before it is saved.
author and author_url are now escaped in the file view and the category file list. Previously stored values are neutralized too.
Added rel="noopener noreferrer" to the author link.
Escaped upload form values when the form is shown again after a validation error.

addition.item: Added new parameter: Allow Unsafe Uploads (Administration)
